findings.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB26-142 for Adobe Campaign Classic
findings.summary_md: Adobe released APSB26-142 on September 8, 2026, addressing critical vulnerabilities in Adobe Campaign Classic v7.4.4 build 9401 and earlier on Windows and Linux. The bulletin identifies multiple unauthenticated flaws including OS command injection (CVE-2026-82004, CVSS 10.0) rated with deployment priority 1, plus additional critical issues reaching the same score. The advisory notes arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, arbitrary file system read, and denial-of-service potential.

findings.title: Adobe Campaign Classic v7 Gets Critical CVSS 10.0 Patch for CVE-2026-82004 — Martech Notes
findings.summary_md: Published September 10, 2026, Martech Notes reports that Adobe's APSB26-142 bulletin covers eight CVSS 10.0 vulnerabilities affecting Campaign Classic v7. The Zero Day Initiative classified the bulletin as priority 1 with deployment urgency. The article notes CVE-2026-82004 (OS command injection, CVSS 10.0) and lists affected builds through v7.4.4 build 9401 on both Windows and Linux platforms.

findings.title: APSB26-142 — Vulners vulnerability database entry
findings.summary_md: Vulners records the Adobe APSB26-142 bulletin with a report date of September 8, 2026, classifying it as critical. The database entry flags arbitrary code execution potential in Adobe Campaign Classic and links back to the official Adobe advisory at helpx.adobe.com. It notes eight critical vulnerabilities with maximum CVSS ratings and references the security feature bypass and file-system read impacts described in the vendor bulletin.
